I will sow the white maize seed I saved from last season because that is what my father taught me and it still feeds my family. I will put three baskets of goat manure on this plot since I own it and want the soil to stay strong, and I will buy a small basin-share of NPK fertilizer from my neighbor because one full bag is too much money for only this small piece. My wife and children will do all the work from planting to harvest — we do not need to pay anyone, and I will not spray medicine or water with a pump because this land is small and the rains will come.
